Validation gates for Semiring / CommutativeSemiring / OrderedSemiring plus the requested Operation and NumberSystems build targets all passed.

items.title: Populate the scalar chain from naturals through rationals
items.notes: Started on 2026-08-30. Chapter I theorem-surface alignment resumed by adding `NaturalNumbers/Constructions/Landau/Laws.lean:LandauWellOrdering` so Theorem 27 now lives under the natural-number owner instead of only the whole-number analogue. Continued the same day by adding the remaining missing Chapter I theorem declarations under `NaturalNumbers/Constructions/Landau/Laws.lean`, bringing `LANDAU-CROSSWALK.md` coverage to Theorems 1-36 end to end. Natural/whole-number theorem surfaces remain unproved by design. Also recorded the Phase 3 subject-interface exception that `NaturalNumbers/Constructions/Landau/*` must not grow a construction-local `NaturalNumberModel` satisfaction file under the current contracts, because the Chapter I carrier is one-based while `NaturalNumberModel` is zero-bearing. That exception does not remove Landau naturals from the algebraic chain generally: they still export promoted generic operator artifacts and can support algebraic-law bundles that do not require additive identity on that carrier. On 2026-08-31, Chunk 02 added `NaturalNumbers/Constructions/Landau/Instances.lean` to package the one-based Landau carrier as a source of `AdditiveCancellativeLaws`, `MultiplicativeIdentityLaws`, `MultiplicativeCancellativeLaws`, and `CommutativeSemiringWithoutZeroLaws`. The same day, `WholeNumbers/Constructions/Landau/Instances.lean` gained `underlyingNaturalCommutativeSemiringWithoutZeroLawsOn` so the zero-adjoined whole-number construction can name its recovered Chapter I law bundle explicitly. `WholeNumbers/Constructions/Landau/Satisfy_Generic.lean` remains the first zero-bearing generic-model owner for that construction line. Also on 2026-08-31, `WholeNumbers/Constructions/Landau/Instances.lean:additionRespectsOrderLawsOn` was further normalized so its `AddLeAddRight` field now consumes the existing named theorem `addition_preserves_nonstrict_order`, and its `AddLeAddLeft` field consumes that same theorem plus additive commutativity on the whole-number carrier, instead of leaving either field as an anonymous placeholder. Also on 2026-08-31, `WholeNumbers/Constructions/Landau/Instances.lean:multiplicationRespectsOrderLawsOn` was normalized so its `MulNonneg` field now consumes the existing named theorem `multiplication_preserves_nonstrict_order` together with the existing zero-absorbing law package on the whole-number carrier, instead of an anonymous placeholder. Also on 2026-08-31, `WholeNumbers/Constructions/Landau/Instances.lean:distributiveLawsOn` was normalized so its second distributivity field now consumes the existing named distributive theorem from `semiring_structure` together with multiplicative commutativity on the whole-number carrier, instead of an anonymous placeholder. Also on 2026-08-31, `WholeNumbers/Constructions/Landau/Instances.lean:quotientOrderedPairsInput` was normalized so the `WholeNumberArithmeticForQuotientPairs.ofCarrier` handoff now consumes the existing named whole-number theorems `additive_structure` and `addition_preserves_and_reflects_nonstrict_order` instead of anonymous `by sorry` placeholders. These are bridge cleanups only and do not clear the integer/rational gate. Also on 2026-08-31, the existing integer and rational Chapter II owners were re-inspected to keep the Landau crosswalk honest without broadening scope: `Integers/Constructions/QuotientOrderedPairs/Laws.lean` already exposes quotient-level additive/distributive theorem stubs, and `RationalNumbers/Constructions/RationalQuotientFractions/Laws.lean` already exposes additive-group, field, strict-total-order, and ordered-field artifacts. That owner inspection does not clear the gate. Integer/rational construction alignment is still gated by the canonical algebraic queue because `as-31` `IntegralDomain` and `as-34` `OrderedField` are not yet marked `done` or explicitly sufficient for this phase. A cross-workstream documentation mismatch also remains on 2026-08-31: `docs/algebraic-structures-repair/status.md` says `as-21 = not_started`, `as-22 = reorg_in_progress`, and `as-25 = reorg_in_progress`, while `docs/algebraic-structures-repair/ledger.json` says `as-21 = reorg_in_progress`, `as-22 = reorg_in_progress` with note text that actually describes `OrderedSemiring`, and `as-25 = not_started`.
